t: This little warm and moist bee can bee found in tropical areas. It produces a special type of super delicious comb.$(br)It can find it's way into cocoa beans even when grown outside of their natural climate.
这种小巧、温暖又湿润的蜜蜂可以在热带地区找到。它会产出一种特别超级美味的蜜脾。$(br)即使可可豆生长在不属于其自然气候的地方，它也能找到它们。

This little warm and moist bee can bee found in tropical areas. It produces a special type of super delicious comb.$(br)It can also find it's way into cocoa beans even when transported and grown outside of their natural climate.
这只又暖又润的小蜜蜂生活在热带地区，产出一种格外美味的蜜脾。$(br)哪怕被带到原生气候之外饲养，它照样找得到可可豆。
